description: This file contains functions related to generating and updating block IDs within a block hierarchy, including handling references and ID mappings, for the focalboard project.

methods.name: GenerateBlockIDs
methods.description: Generates new IDs for a list of blocks, maintaining reference consistency and shape of the block tree.

methods.name: fixFieldIDs
methods.description: Updates IDs within a specified field of a block, based on provided ID mapping functions.
